changes: Version detection now uses APP_VERSION variable instead of reading version.txt
Changelog format changed to JSON (changelog.json) for better data structure
Update prompt shows only the new version's changelog entries
Added macOS (darwin) detection alongside existing Linux, Windows, WSL, and Termux
Removed dependency on external version.txt file; all version info stored in app.py
Enhanced error handling and added multiple try-except blocks for robustness
Fixed 'current: 0.0.0' bug when checking for updates with f-string version
Improved cross-platform compatibility for iOS, WSL, and macOS
Maintained full backward compatibility with all existing features
Fixed hotspot DHCP range validation and configuration
Added colored log output (INFO/WARNING/ERROR) in hotspot monitor
Added automatic update checker with changelog display
Improved hotspot management stability and error handling
Updated hotspot stop to fully reset interfaces and NAT rules
